name: Iki
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Iki, the possessing ghost witnessed as a shadow holding a cord.
ANATOMY: ONE large human-shaped SHADOW only, featureless silhouette with ONE head and TWO arms, one hand holding a plain loose CORD with NO LOOP/NOOSE; NO visible physical person casting this shadow. [iki-c05]
MOMENT: Reach the shadow hand across a plaster lodging-room wall toward viewer, loose cord dangling from its fist; ominous forward lean.
POWER: Documented ghost shadow holding cord; no victim or self-harm action, no hanging body, no instructions or gore. [iki-c05]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle, subject fills80% of square; natural scale unless giant explicitly documented. Important features clear at200pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant warm moonbreak/sunset or documented lantern, dramatic rim light, deep walnut shadows, natural moisture/dust.
SURFACE: tactile natural skin/fur/scales/wood where appropriate, opaque coarse textiles, rough stone, original visible painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Old lodging-house interior, empty adjoining room visible; single oil lamp casts the impossible shadow from no body. [iki-c05]
MOOD: dangerous for hostile beings, awe-inspiring and respectful for gods, guardians and living traditions, never cute/calm/decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text/lettering/logo/border/frame/watermark; no extra heads/limbs/fingers; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons, floating runes.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px and 200px. One huge, featureless humanlike shadow fills the plaster wall of an old lodging-room: one head with ragged hair, and two arms (the left thrust toward the viewer as an enlarged fist, the right hanging with long splayed fingers). Exactly as iki-c05 says, the shadow holds a cord: a plain frayed rope that hangs straight from the fist, with no loop and no noose. The only light is an oil lamp at the left, and no body stands between lamp and wall, so the shadow is impossible. Through the open sliding door the next room is empty (lodger and adjoining room in c05). There is no victim, hanging or self-harm action. The looming fist and towering silhouette are clearly menacing at 200px. Warm walnut palette, no text, aura or borrowed design. The textured, physical-looking cord is an acceptable uncanny editorial choice.
